methodology: Whole standard suite; warm filesystem/toolchain caches. One warmup then 11 fresh application builds, rotating target order. Generated C includes cc -O2/link; native includes ZX frontend, host cc/link and native instantiation. Wasm includes ZX frontend and wasm emission, excludes V8 compilation. Validation outside timing. Go source nonce forces application cache miss; standard-library cache stays warm. No fast compiler mode exists. Symmetric inclusive 1.5xIQR; raw samples retained.
